'''Molten Shell''' is a [[guard skill]] that [[buff]]s the user with a shell that grants bonus [[armour]] and absorbs incoming hits. When the shell expires or absorbs enough damage, it explodes to deal [[fire damage]] around it, based on how much damage it absorbed. The amount of damage the shell can absorb increases with your armour value. 

Base duration is 3 seconds at all gem levels, followed by a 4 second cooldown.

==Skill functions and interactions==
* {{c|mod|Damage from Hits is taken from the Buff}}: In the order of [[receiving damage|mitigation]], the Molten Shell buff takes damage after mitigation and [[aegis]]es, but before the player's main resources like [[ward]] and [[life]].

* '''Buff Effect''': Modifiers to Molten Shell's buff effect (currently limited to {{il|Ichimonji}}) will only affect the armour granted by the skill, not the damage, duration, or absorbed damage required.<ref name="buffeffect"/>

* '''Buff can take Damage equal to #% of your Armour''': The damage limit is calculated after the armour bonus is applied.

* '''Reflected damage''': Because Molten Shell deals [[Damage reflection|reflected damage]], it is unaffected by damage modifiers, cannot crit, penetrate resistances, or apply ailments or other on-hit effects. Its damage cannot be reflected again. 

* '''Guard''': Molten Shell shares a cooldown with other [[guard skill]]s (e.g. {{il|Steelskin}}, {{il|Immortal Call}}).
** '''Vaal Molten Shell''': Molten Shell and {{il|Vaal Molten Shell}} do not share a cooldown. Using one while the other is active replaces the older buff.

==Monster versions==
Monsters may use Molten Shell (with alternative skill effects) if the monster has the mod [[Modifier:MonsterModMagmaBarrier|{{c|mod|of the Barrier}}]], or the legacy [[archnemesis modifier]] {{c|nemesis|Magma Barrier}} which grants the monster multiple skills and effects. [[Goatman Shaman]] also uses Molten Shell and different skill visuals to the player version. Other example is [[General Gravicius]] and his map boss variants.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Now has a level requirement of 16 (previously 4), and a Strength requirement of 41 (previously 16) at gem level 1, and is unchanged at gem level 20.
* As a result of this level requirement change, the Buff now grants +115 to Armour at gem level 1 (previously +50), and is unchanged at gem level 20.
* '''Molten Shell''' is now offered to the Marauder for completing [[Intruders in Black]], and can be purchased from Yeena by the Duelist, Templar, and Scion.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.21.0|
* Molten Shell now has "Buff can take Damage equal to 10% of your Armour, up to a maximum of 5000" at all gem levels (previously 20% of your Armour, up to a maximum of 10000).
* Vaal Molten Shell now has "Buff can take Damage equal to 20% of your Armour, up to a maximum of 10000" at all gem levels (previously 30% of your Armour, up to 30000).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.19.0|
* The Labyrinth Helmet Enchantments that grant increased Molten Shell Buff Effect can no longer be obtained, though existing versions are unaffected.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.3|
* Fixed a bug where the [[reflect|Reflected Damage]] from Divergent [[Molten Shell]] was not penetrating Enemy [[Fire Resistance]].
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* Fixed a bug where Molten Shell's effect would linger indefinitely if the [[skill gem]] were replaced by a {{il|Vaal Molten Shell}} gem during the original gem's [[duration]].
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Now has a base duration of 3 seconds at all gem levels (from 10).
* Now grants 50 additional armour at gem level 1 (from 17), up to 858 at gem level 20 (from 943)
* Now creates a buff that can take damage equal to 20% of your armour.
* Now causes 75% of damage from hits to be taken from the buff before your life or energy shield.
* Updated: Now reflects 100% of damage taken from the buff as fire damage when the buff expires or is depleted at gem level 1, up to 3000% at gem level 20 (previously stated 1050% at gem level 20).
* Now has a 4 second cooldown (from 1).
* No longer has an added damage effectiveness multiplier or critical strike chance, as reflected damage cannot benefit from added damage, nor can it critically strike.
* Shares its cooldown with other guard skills (Steelskin and Immortal Call).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.6.0|
* Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 7 (was 12).
* Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 26 (was 28).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.4.0|
* Mana cost increased to 12 at gem level 1 (up from 8) up to 28 at gem level 20 (same as previously)
* Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving.
* All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less.
* Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine).
}}
{{Version history table row|2.6.0|
*Changed the explosion effect. The new one has better performance.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.3.2|
* When switching between regular and {{il|Vaal Molten Shell}}, the [[shield]] will now visually destroy and recreate itself.
* Fixed a bug where Molten Shell buff effect bonuses did not apply to {{il|Vaal Molten Shell}}.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.2.0|
* Cast time reduced from 1 sec to 500 ms.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.1.0|
* Fixed a bug where Molten Shell could be applied multiple times via Spell Echo.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Greatly reduced the mana cost.
* Now grants 1% chance to ignite per 1% quality (was 1.5% per 1% quality).
}}
{{Version history table row|1.2.0|
* Fixed a bug with Molten Shell and mitigated physical damage reflection. 
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.3c|
*Fixed a bug where Molten Shell sometimes did no damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.3|

* The Molten Shell used by Goatmen has been given new art.
